title: Rehydrate missing metrics and restore trace linking for affected dashboards after ingestion schema drift
creator: Ava Chen
description: Summary: Multiple customers reported missing metrics and broken dashboard panels across Hosted and Dedicated instances and one Private install after a nightly ingestion pipeline migration. Traces were ingesting but trace->metric links broke (missing trace IDs on metric events), resulting in empty latency/time-series panels and stale alerting. Impact: three paying customers escalated (2 enterprise Hosted, 1 Dedicated), several SLOs degraded for dashboards used by customer SREs, and paging caused support time overhead. This ticket tracks diagnosis, immediate remediation, and follow-up hardening.
comments: 2026-03-10 - 09:12 - Ava Chen: Triage call summary: ingestion migration introduced a schema rename for 'span_id' -> 'trace_span_id' in the metrics enricher. Dashboards and alerting still reference old field. Dedicated ingestion nodes running older enricher code did not receive config update, causing partial population.

2026-03-10 - 11:05 - Diego Morales: Reproduced locally with a replay of last 24h events. Confirmed dashboards query for metric.series.trace_span_id is empty when enricher emitted trace_span_id, and conversely some dedicated nodes still provide span_id but our trace-linking job expects trace_id hashing variant. Two root issues: field rename (schema drift) and a trace-id hashing change in runtime 1.17->1.18 that changed link keys.

2026-03-10 - 13:30 - Diego Morales: Emergency hotfix plan: 1) revert the enricher config in hosted pipeline to populate both keys for a 48h compatibility window; 2) deploy a migration job to backfill missing trace links for the last 72h; 3) patch dashboard templates to tolerate either key and add cross-key fallback in queries. Scoped to hosted first, Dedicated next, Private customer on request with upgrade plan.

2026-03-10 - 17:02 - PM note (Lina Patel): Customer communications drafted and approved. Notified affected customers with ETA for hosted fix: 2026-03-11 02:00 UTC. Dedicated customer on call scheduled 2026-03-11 05:00 UTC for patch coordination. Support playbook updated.

2026-03-11 - 01:15 - Diego Morales: Hotfix PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/5824 - implements dual-key emit and query fallback. Added unit tests for both field names and an integration test replaying synthetic trace/metric pairs. Requesting urgent review from infra and runtime teams.

2026-03-11 - 03:40 - Infra reviewer (Maya Singh): Reviewed PR, requested additional monitoring and a metric to track dual-key emission ratio. Also requested a feature flag for dual emission that can be toggled per-region to minimize blast radius.

2026-03-11 - 05:55 - Diego Morales: Deployed hotfix to hosted ingestion region us-west-2 behind feature flag. Verified dashboards began populating; alerts started firing on restored series. Sent update to customers. Observability dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/obs-restore-21987 (internal).
2026-03-11 - 08:40 - Customer (Enterprise A): Confirmed metrics restored and acknowledged decrease in PagerDuty noise. Asked for timeline to remediate Dedicated cluster and private appliance.

2026-03-11 - 12:20 - Diego Morales: Started backfill job: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/actions/runs/65812 - backfill covers last 72h, idempotent. Estimated 3h runtime for affected time windows. Noted a small race where some events had both keys but inconsistent trace-id hashing; backfill includes a normalization pass.

2026-03-11 - 16:00 - Support (Rohan Mehta): Dedicated customer patch applied to their cluster; on-site upgrade window coordinated. Private customer requested a manual runbook instead of automated backfill; assigned to solutions engineering.

2026-03-12 - 09:00 - Diego Morales: Backfill completed for hosted regions. Verified alerting thresholds returned to normal. Added retention check to ingestion to avoid TTL-induced losses seen on the Private install (misapplied TTL during earlier upgrade removed intermediate enrichment records).

2026-03-12 - 11:30 - Ava Chen: Post-fix checklist started: 1) schedule postmortem, 2) add schema compatibility tests to CI, 3) add dashboard query fallbacks, 4) improve upgrade playbook for Private installs, 5) add synthetic end-to-end trace->metric tests.
2026-03-12 - 15:10 - QA (Samuel Park): Integration test failures observed on a legacy Dedicated image; created ENG-22012 to track image pinning for enricher components.

2026-03-12 - 16:45 - Diego Morales: Marking this ticket In Progress with next actions: merge hotfix PR after sign-off, roll hotfix to all regions, finalize backfill for Dedicated cluster, create follow-up reliability iteration (ENG-22100) for long-term fixes.
